architecture.pattern: connector registry plus a public-RPC scanner with an exact-simulation execution gate
architecture.isolation_boundaries: the scanner emits non-executable protocol intents; providers discover executor-ready opportunities; the executor alone signs and broadcasts
execution_flow: validate environment configuration and risk policy
index finalized protocol events and validate live scanner candidates without a wallet
discover executor-ready opportunities from registered data providers
build and simulate every permitted allocation tier
repeat exact preflight and broadcast through the verified executor

test_criteria: configuration defaults and validation are covered
every tier is simulated before selection
an invalid split allocation cannot broadcast
the final executor adapter preflights immediately before send
scan mode rejects execution flags and never constructs a wallet client
scan output distinguishes Balancer callback loans from Uniswap v4 unlock delta settlement
